task_spec.text: Show me the messages posted by an admin-role member of the Test Workspace team that lay out the plan to rewrite circuit-tracer in PyTorch for multi-GPU support.

access_plan: Resolve the workspace by name via teams (team_name = 'Test Workspace') to its team_id, then find its admin-role members via user_teams (role='admin', team_id matches); for each such user, scan their authored messages across channels/DMs discoverable through conversations.list/history/replies and users.info for the circuit-tracer PyTorch multi-GPU rewrite topic.
